name: sgs/hero
title: SGS Hero
description: Page hero section with headline, sub-headline, CTAs, and background image.

sgs._comment_hoverSpillScale: 2026-09-10, Bean-directed — shared wrapper capability (class-sgs-container-wrapper.php), migrated off hero's own private CSS. Promotes the whole composite root's stacking context above a document-later sibling and lets the split-media hover-zoom spill past its column without a page-level horizontal scrollbar. Universal — targets the shared .sgs-media-box/.sgs-media-el marker pair, so it applies to ANY composite that opts in, not just hero. Inert on the standard variant (no .sgs-media-box descendant there).

wrapper.label: Wrapper
wrapper._note_animation: The animation cluster (anim:*) has no member on this block: its motion is the sgsMotion model (Spec 38A), not attributes. D701 (2026-08-20): `borderColourGradient` (resting) added as the base-level sibling to `borderColourHoverGradient` — the wrapper's resting border colour comes from WP-native `__experimentalBorder.color` (already mapped above at `css:border-color`), and this new gradient wins over that native solid colour at render time when set (mirrors `borderColourHover`/`borderColourHoverGradient` and `sgs/quote`'s `borderColour`/`borderColourGradient` pair). See render.php for the emission order that makes the override work without `!important`. D702 (2026-08-20): `css:background-color`/`css:color` retargeted from the dead `native:color.background` reference (WordPress never registered that attribute — `supports.color` was absent) to the plain `backgroundColour`/`textColour` string attrs, mirroring `sgs/testimonial-slider`'s `slider` element. The hover pair (`backgroundColourHover`/`textColourHover`) was already declared on this block but bound to nothing until now.

inner.absentWhy: The split variant content/media grid is the section root itself (render.php passes wrap_inner false), so no band element exists; a layer on the root reaches the grid.
inner.label: Inner (grid / flex layout)
inner._note: The content/media split grid (named regions content + media; the `supports.sgs.gridAreas` flag that used to name them was deleted D639 — the regions are defined by the contentPadding/mediaPadding attrs themselves). Declares no `prefix` so arrangement members map explicitly. No `display`, `align-items`, `order` or `overflow` attribute exists on this block — honest GAPs, not omissions.

content-band.absentWhy: The split variant content/media grid is the section root itself (render.php passes wrap_inner false), so no band element exists; a layer on the root reaches the grid.
content-band.label: Content band
content-band._note: Mirrors sgs/container's content-band — the content-width constraining band, independent of the `content` grid-area below. Padding maps explicitly to the block's `padding` attribute.

content.label: Content column
content._note: The `content` grid-area (headline/sub-headline/CTA column in the split variant). background-color and padding both resolve via the default convention (contentBackground, contentPadding). css:background-image is explicitly attrMapped to contentBackgroundGradient because the default {prefix}{suffix} convention has no 'BackgroundGradient' candidate (only 'BackgroundImage'/'Overlay*' suffixes exist for this member) — found live 2026-08-15 during element-manifest-drift triage. REPOINTED 2026-08-16 (D643): this mapped `contentBackgroundGradientFrom`, an attribute deleted by the D636 storage collapse (837f7c97) — the manifest had been claiming a non-existent attr. The accepted-orphan note about a `...To` sibling is gone with it: one string attr now holds the whole gradient, so there is no second colour stop to strand.

media.absentWhy: The media column exists only in the split variant.
media.label: Media column
media._note: The `media` grid-area: the grid cell around the split media. Column placement is `splitContentOrder`. The media itself is the `split-media` element below; its settings are the split slot.

headline.label: Headline
headline._note: Typography REPOINTED to the `wrapper` element 2026-09-05 (D971/D972 full-replacement track — migrated off WP-native `supports.typography` onto the shared TypographyControls/sgs_typography_css_rule() mechanism, prefix ''). `_selectorsNote` above already corrected `selectors.typography` from `.sgs-hero__headline` to the block root `.wp-block-sgs-hero` on 2026-09-02 because this class is never emitted by hero's own rendered markup — so these controls were always the WRAPPER's, never this element's, and the migration completes that correction rather than reversing it. `native:color.text` stays mapped here for now even though native `supports.color.text` is disabled (`false`) on this block — a pre-existing dead mapping, out of scope for this migration. `headlineMarginBottom` (the standalone parent-side spacing override) was RETIRED 2026-08-12 (Spec 35 Phase 2.3, Bean-confirmed dead — its live values were scratch-page defaults, not deliberate client settings) — no layout member remains on this element.

sub-headline.label: Sub-headline
sub-headline._note: No dedicated typography attrs — inherits the wrapper's native typography. `subHeadlineMaxWidth`/`subHeadlineMarginBottom` were RETIRED 2026-08-12 (Spec 35 Phase 2.3, same as headlineMarginBottom above) — nothing layout-shaped remains on this element.

cta.label: CTA buttons
cta._note: CTAs render via InnerBlocks (sgs/multi-button > sgs/button children, FR-22-6) — no scalar cta* content/style attrs remain on this block, so nothing to cluster-map here.

split-media.absentWhy: The split media exists only in the split variant.
split-media.label: Split media
split-media._note: The split media element the renderer prints (`SGS_Media_Element::render`, class `sgs-hero__split-media`); every setting is a split slot attribute.

background.label: Background
background._note: `.sgs-bg-media`, the element SGS_Container_Wrapper prints for every background (picture, tile layer, video or SVG). A motion target so a Ken Burns or parallax layer moves the background alone, never the block's content; it declares no style clusters because its look is governed by the Background panel.

svg-bg.label: Background SVG
svg-bg._note: `.sgs-container__svg-bg`, the wrapper SGS_Container_Wrapper prints around a background or foreground SVG (bgSvg*). A motion target so a `draw` effect layer reaches the SVG alone.

background-video.label: Background video
background-video._note: The same `.sgs-bg-media` element when a device shows a video: an effect that suits video (not Ken Burns) reaches it through this part.

_selectorsNote: S1 fix (2026-09-02, uniformity sweep, inspector-scan rule 33): selectors.typography retargeted from '.sgs-hero__headline' to the block root ('.wp-block-sgs-hero', matching info-box/notice-banner). '.sgs-hero__headline' is set ONLY as an InnerBlocks TEMPLATE child's className in edit.js, never emitted by hero's own rendered markup — the old selector generated a scoped rule at CSS specificity (0,2,0) that could never beat the child block's own inline typography at (1,0,0,0), so hero's 7 declared native typography controls were silent no-ops (Spec 35A F.1).

attributes._comment_typography: D971/D972 full-replacement track (2026-09-05) — root prefix '' (wrapper element), replacing the deleted WP-native `supports.typography`. Mirrors sgs/accordion's already-migrated shape exactly. letterSpacing/letterSpacingUnit/textTransform are ADDITIONAL to the base fontSize/fontSizeUnit/fontWeight/fontStyle/lineHeight/lineHeightUnit set because the native support being replaced actually declared AND render.php actually consumed both (the old selector was broken — see block.json's `_selectorsNote` — but the attributes were live, not dead, so dropping them here would be a real scope reduction, not a cleanup).

backgroundColour.description: Resting (non-hover) root background colour, bound to the wrapper element's css:background-color (D702). Distinct from the decorative backgroundOverlayColour/overlayGradient dimming layer.

backgroundColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the resting root background instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over backgroundColour at render time (mirrors the borderColour/borderColourGradient pair).

backgroundColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the hover root background instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over backgroundColourHover at render time.

textColour.description: Resting (non-hover) root text colour, bound to the wrapper element's css:color (D702).

textColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the resting root text colour (background-clip: text) instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over textColour at render time.

textColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the hover root text colour (background-clip: text) instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over textColourHover at render time.

borderColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the hover border instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over borderColourHover at render time (D636).

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the resting (non-hover) border instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over the WP-native __experimentalBorder.color at render time (D701).

splitBorderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the split media border instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over splitBorderColour at render time (D636).

surfaceBlur.description: Backdrop blur: a single CSS length (for example 24px) that blurs whatever sits behind this block. Emitted by SGS_Container_Wrapper via includes/helpers-surface-ground.php; empty emits nothing.

surfaceSaturate.description: Backdrop saturation as a whole-number percentage (for example 150), paired with surfaceBlur. Unset emits nothing; 0 is a legal value.

padding.description: Base (desktop) padding, owned outright — hero declares NO supports.spacing, so before 2026-08-21 this control wrote to style.spacing and WordPress DISCARDED it on save (D338/D587 class). Matches the D555/D707 container shape.

contentGap.description: Space between the stacked items of the content column (eyebrow, heading, text, buttons) per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a CSS length or a bare number of px. Unset prints no gap.
